Bank of America charges overdraft fees when a transaction exceeds your available balance [3]. Here's what likely happened:

Your available balance includes not just posted transactions, but also pending ones still processing. A check or payment you wrote may have posted while an earlier purchase (like gas) was still being processed. Even though you thought you had enough, that pending transaction lowered your available balance below the check amount, causing the overdraft [4].

- View your **Account Balance History** in Online Banking to see how pending transactions affected your available balance and the order things posted [3][4]

If you want to avoid overdraft fees entirely, you can ask Bank of America to apply the **Decline All** overdraft setting—transactions will be declined instead of charged [2].
